summary: Diff adds three new files. slug.py defines slugify(), which lowercases, strips, replaces non-alphanumeric runs with hyphens, and trims edge hyphens; it contains a deliberate typo (.stip()) so the fixture fails. test_slug.py adds three pytest cases for basic, whitespace, and punctuation input. tactics.md is a debug-loop reference covering git bisect, building a check when none exists, hooks as gates, subagent delegation, overfitted fixes, and context hygiene.

claims.text: slugify calls text.lower().stip(), a misspelling of strip(); every test will raise AttributeError.
Tests import slug by inserting the fixture parent directory onto sys.path.
test_collapses_punctuation expects 'v2.0 -- final!' to become 'v2-0-final'; regex plus edge strip supports this once typo is fixed.
git bisect finds the culprit in about 10 steps across 1,000 commits.
Claude Code overrides a Stop hook after 8 consecutive blocks.
A subagent run costs about three times the tokens of the same work inline.
